_comment: GATEWAY-ROUTED tools. Both MCP servers point at the WGU Solo Agent Gateway's /mcp routes instead of the vendors directly, so every tool call flows through one governed door (auth/policy/rate-limit/observability). No token in config. type=streamable-http per Agent Plugins v1 spec (closed transport union) + matches the proven zackwy/plugins reference. LOCAL values use the port-forward at http://localhost:4000. PRODUCTION swaps these to https://gateway.wgu.edu/mcp/<tool>. AUTH NOTE: full per-user auth through the gateway requires Entra on-behalf-of (OBO / ID-JAG crossAppAccess) at the gateway — designed, not yet built; until then the gateway routes/logs traffic but does not itself perform the vendor OAuth. See docs/adr/007-mcp-tool-authentication.md in WGU-edu/wgu-devex-platform.
